### Build Yourselves Up
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/build-yourselves
Passage: Jude 1:20-21
Points:
- Believers must actively ground their lives in the foundational apostolic teachings of Scripture.
- Building up faith is not solitary but a corporate responsibility shared with other believers.
- Keeping oneself in God's love involves biblical prayer in the Holy Spirit and faithful fellowship.
- Eagerly awaiting the final mercy of Christ gives Christians perseverance in the face of error.

### Your Berean Battle Plan: Rescue
Author: Grace to You
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/B150821/your-berean-battle-plan-rescue
Passage: Jude 1:22-23
Points:
- Contending for biblical truth must never replace the church's evangelistic mission to reach the lost.
- People who have embraced dangerous falsehood require an urgent and direct rescue with God's truth.
- Believers should extend mercy even toward deceivers while guarding against the corrupting influence of their sin.
- Christians can confidently engage in difficult rescue efforts knowing they are eternally kept in God's care.
